class.name: Newgrounds
class.description: Unlocks medals, submits scores, and reads or writes cloud saves. Secure calls wait in a queue until the player is signed in.

method.name: unlock_medal
method.description: Unlocks a medal. The call is queued while signed out.

method.name: submit_score
method.description: Submits a score. The call is queued while signed out.

method.name: cloud_save
method.description: Writes a cloud save. The call is queued while signed out.

method.name: cloud_load
method.description: Requests a cloud save. The value arrives through [signal result].
